To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

“We present an autonomous low power IoT controller for industrial PV solar panel cleaning systems, that implements advanced features such as remote monitoring, VPN, and other security mechanisms that are not available in current solutions”.

(a) the system is designed to be low power, autonomous and to operate in harsh environments; (b) the system is capable of running VPN and iptables; (c) the system can be remotely monitored and controlled; (d) the system is able to communicate with other devices via the internet; (e) the system is flexible, meaning that it can be adapted to different applications.

(1) we designed an architecture for a low-power IoT controller that is capable of performing autonomous solar panel cleaning, (2) we designed and built an autonomous solar panel cleaning solution that is based on a custom designed IoT controller and that can be remotely monitored and operated via the internet, and (3) we implemented and tested the solution in the field, and the results show that it can operate autonomously for a long time (more than 3 months) without the need for external energy source
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of a low power autonomous Industrial Internet of Things (IoT) Controller for PV solar panels cleaning.

the development of a low power autonomous Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) controller, capable of being remotely monitored, controlled, and managed, and capable of implementing security features such as VPN and firewalls.
the development and implementation of an autonomous IoT controller that will be able to monitor and control the PV plant and its cleaning mechanism, and to be connected to a remote control center.

the presented architecture and implementation is capable of providing a cost-effective solution to the solar panel cleaning problem, with the ability to be easily integrated into the current PV plants, and with the ability to provide the PV plant owner with the ability to monitor the system remotely, and to be able to control it from any location in the world, with no need for human intervention, and with the added security features that current systems cannot provide.

the proposed architecture and implementation is capable of controlling the operation of a PV panels cleaning solution, while at the same time, being connected to the Internet and having the ability to be remotely monitored, and to run advanced security features.
